name: Tuvalu
impact: Rising ocean tides are flooding coastal areas and contaminating their fresh drinking water with salt.

name: Kiribati
impact: Severe coastal erosion is washing away homes and poisoning crop soils, forcing relocation plans.

name: Fiji
impact: Villages are being forced to relocate inland, diverting vital public funds to build new seawalls.

name: Samoa
impact: Violent storm surges are destroying key coastal roads and flooding low-lying family communities.

name: Tonga
impact: Acidic waters are killing protective coral reefs and depleting the fish populations they depend on.

name: Solomon Islands
impact: Rising seas are ruining agricultural soil, forcing families to rely on expensive imported food.

name: Vanuatu
impact: Experiencing catastrophic category-5 cyclones and unpredictable whiplash weather cycles.

name: Nauru
impact: Spiking water temperatures are bleaching protective reefs, threatening local fish supplies.

name: Niue
impact: Their underground freshwater supply is highly vulnerable to sea level rise and storms.

name: Cook Islands
impact: Bleached coral reefs can no longer buffer the shores, leaving coastal homes exposed to ocean waves.

name: Guam
impact: More frequent and intense typhoons are battering local infrastructure and bleaching coral reefs.

name: Micronesia
impact: Regular flooding during high spring tides is contaminating farm soils and crop gardens.

name: Marshall Islands
impact: King tides now flood lagoon streets regularly, while heat stress is collapsing local coral reefs.

name: Palau
impact: Spiking water temperatures threaten rare marine species in their world-famous marine lakes.
